annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg (Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics)
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines L3 conditionally and L4 highly automated road vehicles and requires national declaration of circulation in addition to EU type approval and registration
Mandatory continuous remote management by a ministerially approved (5-year agrément) remote manager with trained remote operators and insurance
Manufacturer duties: safety equivalent to a prudent human driver, software updates, cybersecurity, incident reporting, data recorders, user information
Criminal liability allocated among driver, remote operator and manufacturer; civil liability left to common law and product liability law
Authorisation for automated transport services and automated parking facilities; data transmission to authorities and technical accident investigation
annotation.summary_en: Luxembourg draft law on automated-driving road vehicles (SAE L3 and L4+), with commentary. It sets type-approval plus a national circulation declaration, manufacturer duties, licensed remote managers and operators, authorisation of automated transport services and parking, data recording, and allocation of criminal liability. Civil liability stays under common law.
annotation.title_clean: Projet de loi relative aux véhicules routiers à conduite automatisée
annotation.title_en: Draft law on automated-driving road vehicles
